decision: closed_no_credit: The reviewed research does not establish a qualifying benefit for this product's assessed use. Single-owner ruling: BB-12 infant-colic credit lives in the strain registry (STRAIN_LACTIS_BB12), not this backed record.
summary: Dr. Pham's fifth ruling makes the strain registry the one scoring owner. This backed record moves to the reference path with the verified 31797399 infant-colic trial recorded as research only. The September 2026 RCT 42775119 (78 completers) was checked: its product is a Bifidobacterium lactis plus FOS drop with no strain deposit or registration, so it is not an exact-strain replication and adds no points.

record_updates.notes: BB-12 has multiple human strain-specific trials with strongest consistency in selected GI and immune outcomes; effects vary by population and protocol. 2026-10-28: per Dr. Pham's fifth ruling, the clinical-strain registry (STRAIN_LACTIS_BB12) is the single scoring owner for BB-12; this backed record is research-only.

identity.standardization: Deposit DSM 15954; Bifidolactis Infant drops (Sofar SpA)

population.description: 80 exclusively breastfed infants aged <=7 weeks with Rome III infant colic (40 per group).

study_contexts.study_design: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial; parental reassurance in both arms.

outcomes.name: Primary: >=50% reduction in daily crying at 28 days, 80.0% vs 32.5% (ITT), P<0.0001

limitations: Research-only in this backed record: Dr. Pham's fifth ruling (2026-10-28) approves one scoring owner, the clinical-strain registry entry STRAIN_LACTIS_BB12 (scripts/data/clinically_relevant_strains.json), which already credits infant colic for this trial and 34550055. No points are awarded from this record.
Signature bookkeeping: the registry colic contexts keep their historical 2026-09-22 note 'not a clinician sign-off'; Dr. Pham's 2026-10-28 rulings now cover their scope.

Inventory finding, 42775119 (Adv Biomed Res 2026; full text PMC13597045): 'BBcare' drops (Zist Takhmir, Iran) described as Bifidobacterium lactis at >=1x10^9 CFU per drop plus fructooligosaccharides, 5 drops/day for 6 weeks; 40 vs 38 completers; no strain deposit number, no trial registration and no designated primary endpoint; a synbiotic product, so it is not an exact-strain replication and adds no points.
Context authored and source-verified by agent review (Claude) on 2026-10-28; Dr. Pham's pre-approval of fully source-verified contexts attested by Sean on 2026-10-28.
